I’m so excited to share that I had the opportunity to test out the Sony FX5 these past few weeks! I brought it with me around some of the lesser explored places in Manila, like Dangwa. Here are my favorite features! Open Gate - So excited about this one because Sony finally listened! You shoot once and you can get a frame that you can reshape however you want: horizontal or vertical, it’s really up to you! As a creator who has both Instagram and YouTube, it’s so exciting to finally have the Open Gate feature because now I don't have to worry so much about compromising a good frame   Triple Base ISO (800 / 4000 / 12800) - Before, I’d often feel the big jump from one base ISO to another. The FX5 gives you more options so the transition feels smoother. Two features and they've already changed how I plan a shoot 🤍 Lighting the way forward with the Sony FX5. #CinemaLineFX5 ​ #SonyAlpha​ #SonyPH The biggest thank you's to @juanderwater for helping me film BTS for this, and to @diarynijib and @charlyn_cua for the assist! 🎬✨️ #cinematography #traveltiktok

A Mosquito in the Ear “Now Streaming on Apple & Prime” . An American couple travels to India to finally meet their newly adopted young daughter and bring her home. What they find is a child who has no intention of leaving the orphanage she knows as her world. As language barriers, cultural differences, and raw emotions collide, the hopeful beginning of a family turns into a tense, intimate struggle. Based on the Italian graphic novel Una Zanzara nell’Orecchio, the film follows the couple’s attempt to connect with a girl who is not ready to trust them, forcing everyone involved to confront what it truly means to become a family. A tender, honest, and quietly powerful drama about adoption, belonging, and the messy first steps of love.
